reason: I post my own flyers in Canva and I do not run a cash till with M-Pesa payments in it. A design studio selling an AI agent that checks payments is not something I came looking for, and it reads like a concept rather than something I can sign up for.
objection: Why would a design studio be the one to trust with my payments, and how would it connect to my till without me paying for something I do not need?
would_change_my_mind: A free trial on my own till that shows it matching real payments correctly, with a clear monthly price before I hand over any details.
